fieldValues.title: RFC-004 Change A: Add json as a core Field value type
fieldValues.proposed_change: `Field.valueType` gains `json` for structured JSON values whose meaning is supplied by the field definition and validating schema. This supports recursive or nested semantic values such as type expressions and portable constraints.
fieldValues.rationale: `json` is a storage primitive for structured semantic values inside SRS records; it is not a target renderer.
